dct_description_sm: This layer depicts the surfaces of roads across Kingston. The data differentiates between types such as paved with curbs, paved without curbs, mixed curbed surfaces, and unpaved roads. It reflects current conditions with regular updates aligned with recent aerial imagery acquisitions, ensuring accuracy for general presentation and analysis purposes.
